logs.title: Activity Log
logs.subtitle: Every device operation, consent record and error is recorded here and can be exported for troubleshooting.

preparation.consentRecorded: Risk acknowledgement and disclaimer acceptance recorded for plan {plan}
preparation.nativeFinished: Device environment and AppSync installation verified
preparation.nativeFailed: Preparation failed; review the failed step and recovery guidance
preparation.nativeCancelled: Cancelled at a safe checkpoint; completed changes remain
preparation.closeBlocked: Preparation is running. Wait for completion or cancel at a safe step before closing.

store.authorized: Application operation authorized for the selected device
store.completed: Application operation completed; see its result in Installed apps
store.closeBlocked: Wait for application operations or cancel them before closing
